data.explanation: Your US-based student health insurer needs more documents to process your emergency room claim. Send an itemized bill (a detailed invoice from the hospital) and proof that you paid it, for example a receipt or bank statement. The documents must be received by 30 September 2026. Otherwise the claim will be closed and you may not be reimbursed. Send them to the claims e-mail address or phone the insurer if unsure. Keep copies of everything you send.
